title: Define character resume conflict policies
description: Record the product semantics for resume conflicts before more code lands. Design-only: capture the policy in ADR 0012 (or a small follow-up design doc), no implementation. Parent: eshyra-lupf.14.4.
acceptance_criteria:
- Define what happens when a campaign resumes with a registry-linked character whose registry head is ahead of the campaign copy.
- Distinguish at least: fail closed; catch-up-to-head; explicit alternate-timeline fork; future-detour/out-of-order continuity.
- State that automatic mechanical merge/rejoin is NOT supported.
- Define who narrates catch-up continuity: player, DM, or selectable.
- Define special handling/warnings for mid-scene and combat resumes.
- Update ADR 0012 or add a small follow-up design doc.
